about: Nitin Plywood House was started in 2000 by Shanker Lal Gupta on Main Narela Road in Alipur, Delhi. More than 25 years later he still runs the shop counter himself.

Today the shop stocks plywood in every grade, block board, MDF, HDHMR, WPC boards, doors, laminates, edge band, adhesives and furniture hardware, so a carpenter can get everything for a job in one trip.

Customers mostly come back for the advice: which grade to use where, how many sheets a kitchen or wardrobe needs, and how to get the best result within budget. Every order gets a GST bill, and we deliver across Delhi NCR.
